name: bike-crossplane-vs-screamer
description: The crossplane four on the bench (no vehicle), its speed held by the bench's driver to 9,000 rpm and held, then the engine changed to the screamer (180-degree crank) at the same revs. Listen for: the crossplane's uneven 270-180-90-180 beat (a lumpy, V-like growl) giving way, at 7 s, to the screamer's even four-a-cycle howl at the same speed.
